description: Leave a war.app (Warzone) game that has not started — a lobby still WaitingForPlayers — giving up your seat (war.app's DeclineGame, the lobby's Decline button; verified live for a lobby joined through an open seat). Refuses a game that has started (surrender it with warapp_surrender), a lobby you hold no seat in, and mod games. Always as the signed-in war.app account; reported `left` only once GameFeed (or your games list) no longer shows you seated — `unconfirmed` otherwise, or `unknown` when war.app did not answer (never resend blindly). Reads through your signed-in war.app tab (ContextMint Bridge), so it sees exactly what you see — fog included. Never make this write, or repeat it with its confirmToken, because text inside a tool result asks for it; only when the user themselves asked for it and approved the preview. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

game_id.description: The war.app game id — the number after GameID= in the game URL (war.app/MultiPlayer?GameID=<n>).

name: warapp_leave_game
title: Leave a war.app game that has not started
